set: LEGO Technic 42175 Volvo EC230 Electric Excavator (excavator booklet, bags 12-17)

input.model_so_far: Tall L-beam on the long beam (step 42).

what_each_new_part_touches: The new 11-hole beam is pressed onto the three pins of step 42 and lies parallel to the first beam.
where_everything_is_after: two parallel 11-hole beams carry the tall post and twin posts between them

why.problem_solved: Doubles the beam so the unit is wide and stiff.
why.why_these_parts: A second beam locked on pins makes a sandwich.
why.sets_up_for_later: Later steps fit the pins and connectors along it.

review_note: Which three beam holes hold the pins is not countable.
